mutations.name: the tap forwards an agent's frames as message again, so every browser receives every agent's frames whether or not anyone watches
mutations.find: const agent = channel === undefined ? null : eventChannelPrincipal(channel);
mutations.replace: const agent = null as { owner: string; actor: string } | null;
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 a chat message on events.local.abc is an agent-frame for local.abc, not a message
mutations.cell: 1.1 a chat message on events.local.abc is an agent-frame for local.abc, not a message

mutations.name: the tap forwards a frame on an agent's event channel whoever published it, so another principal can write into that agent's session
mutations.expectRed: 1.10 a frame on events.local.abc published by local.mallory comes back null: not the agent's frame, and never a message
mutations.cell: 1.10 a frame on events.local.abc published by local.mallory comes back null: not the agent's frame, and never a message

mutations.name: a repeated watch from one feed is counted twice, so that feed receives each frame twice and one unwatch no longer matches one watch
mutations.expectRed: 2.1 two watches from one feed count once
mutations.cell: 2.1 two watches from one feed count once

mutations.name: a closed feed's watches are never forgotten, so the map keeps a dead connection per agent it ever watched
mutations.expectRed: 2.6 drop removes a feed from every agent it watched
mutations.cell: 2.6 drop removes a feed from every agent it watched

mutations.name: the per-feed ceiling is gone, so one browser can grow the watch map without bound by asking for ids nobody runs
mutations.expectRed: 2.9 a feed already at the ceiling is refused a new agent as a bad request, and holds what it held
mutations.cell: 2.9 a feed already at the ceiling is refused a new agent as a bad request, and holds what it held

mutations.name: the history read asks for limit rather than limit + 1, so it can never learn that an earlier page exists and Load earlier is never offered
mutations.expectRed: 4.2 more is true when limit + 1 came back
mutations.cell: 4.2 more is true when limit + 1 came back

mutations.name: a broker refusal rethrows instead of answering, so a per-user mesh shows a 503 rather than the refusal and the grant that fixes it
mutations.expectRed: 4.7 a denial answers { refused } with the error's text unchanged and the grant grantFor gave
mutations.cell: 4.7 a denial answers { refused } with the error's text unchanged and the grant grantFor gave

mutations.name: a feed that falls behind is never ended, so a slow browser watching a busy agent buffers in this process without limit
mutations.expectRed: 6.2 a live event over a backlog past the ceiling is not written: the feed gets one overflow event with its reason, and is ended
mutations.cell: 6.2 a live event over a backlog past the ceiling is not written: the feed gets one overflow event with its reason, and is ended

mutations.name: the ceiling is measured after the write, so one event larger than the ceiling on its own, such as one long chat message, ends every feed it reaches
mutations.expectRed: 6.4 one live event larger than the ceiling, over an empty backlog, is written and the feed stays open
mutations.cell: 6.4 one live event larger than the ceiling, over an empty backlog, is written and the feed stays open

mutations.name: the connect snapshots are held to the ceiling, so a mesh whose roster is larger than it ends every new feed straight after connect, in a reconnect loop
mutations.expectRed: 6.5 the connect snapshots are never held to the ceiling: a roster larger than it, and the state after it, are written and the feed stays open
mutations.cell: 6.5 the connect snapshots are never held to the ceiling: a roster larger than it, and the state after it, are written and the feed stays open

mutations.name: the /feed route writes its roster as a live event, so on a big mesh the roster alone counts toward the ceiling
mutations.expectRed: 6.6 the /feed route writes hello, the roster, the presence view and the membership seed (or its refusal) as snapshots
mutations.cell: 6.6 the /feed route writes hello, the roster, the presence view and the membership seed (or its refusal) as snapshots
